name: Tiana
source:
The Prideful Investigator

Extroverted and boastful, Tiana solves every problem by jumping in headfirst. Her prideful nature often puts her at odds with her rival, Shana, but whether it's solving cases or teasing you, Tiana knows what she wants. Will you be the one to put her ego in check or will you fall prey to her charms?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.holmes]Google Play[/url]]
